result.question: What sign does the man of God give?

readings.answer: That the altar will be split apart and its ashes poured out.
readings.support: Surely the altar will be split apart, and the ashes upon it will be poured out.

assessments.reason: Verse 13:3 states the sign exactly: the altar will split and its ashes will be poured out, matching the reading.

result.reason: The passage explicitly gives the sign as the altar splitting and its ashes pouring out, which the reading correctly states.
